title: 第9章 龙象功忽悠至尊族妹叫哥哥第10章 万倍返还上品圣兵星落弓
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
顾清秋？
昨天晚上来序列府了吗？
看样子这位重生至尊族妹挺会做人嘛，先过来给自已请安，并且让侍女在这里等了一夜。
顾长歌眼睛微微一眯，微笑道：“清秋族妹来了吗？带她过来我院子吧。”
“好的神子！”
侍女点点头，悄悄羞赧看了眼顾长歌，随即碎步离去。
顾长歌想起昨天顾清秋的面板，心中一动，查看起来，他没有记错的话，貌似可以查看顾清秋的近期运势来着。
这个功能，顾长歌感觉是自已日后起飞的关键之一啊！
【昵称：顾清秋】
【身份：长生顾家支脉之女、重生至尊】
【实力：开脉境九层！
【体质：至尊骨！
【功法：虚空经！
【神通：虚空大手印！
【近期运势：……】
查看顾清秋的面板，顾长歌一下瞪大了眼睛。
不是！
卧槽。
一个晚上，发生了什么东西？
顾清秋仅仅是修炼一个晚上，就到开脉九层了？我勒个去。

这就是重生至尊的逆天吗？
修炼就跟吃饭喝水一样？
至于顾清秋会虚空经，很正常。
对方可是重生至尊，提前掌握长生顾家帝境功法没有什么奇怪的。
离谱就离谱在对方的实力面板上。
可以说比起前一天，那简直翻天覆地，最后顾长歌视线落在顾清秋的近期运势上面。
【近期运势：陨落重生女帝，本来应该继续和前世那般命运坎坷，底蕴被挖，可天命难测，冥冥当中已经发生了不可预料的变化，如今至尊骨依旧藏于身中，加持前世至尊见识，已经有一飞冲天大运，得长生顾家神子庇佑培养，实力将会继续暴涨，一个月后将会和长生顾家神子一同参加成人礼试炼，在虚空秘境中得圣级《龙象功》……】
看到龙象功三个字之后，顾长歌已经无法继续看到后面的文字。
应该是接下来的运势顾长歌看不到了。
不过单单是前面这些信息就能够让顾长歌好一阵消化了。
“果然系统的绑定返还目标不简单，单单是这一点点近期运势，竟然就可以看到获得一门圣级锻体功法。”
“后面还不知道获得什么惊天机缘！”
“圣级锻体功法，哪怕是长生顾家也仅仅只有十来本收藏而已，并且这门龙象功竟然能够入顾清秋这个重生至尊，以及系统的眼，恐怕非同凡响！”
“要是我截胡之后，再赠予顾清秋返还的话。”
“嘶……那不原地起飞？”
本来有仙骨孕养肉身，顾长歌肉身之力已经远超常人，要是再修炼非凡锻体功法，怕不是肉身无敌！
好好好。
顾长歌一想到这里，已经开始期待起来了。
content_en:
Gu Qingqiu?
Did you come to Sequence Mansion last night?
It seems that this reborn supreme clan girl is quite good at being a good person. She came over to pay her respects first and asked her maid to wait here all night.
Gu Changge narrowed his eyes slightly and said with a smile: "Is the Qingqiu clan sister here? Bring her to my yard."
"Okay, Son of God!"
The maid nodded, glanced at Gu Changge quietly and shyly, and then walked away.
Gu Changge thought of Gu Qingqiu's dashboard yesterday, and his heart moved. After checking it, if he remembered correctly, it seemed that he could check Gu Qingqiu's recent fortune.
Gu Changge feels that this function is one of the keys to his future success!
[Nickname: Gu Qingqiu]
[Identity: Daughter of a branch of the Gu family of Changsheng, reborn supreme]
[Strength: Ninth Level of Pulse Opening Realm!
[Physique: Supreme Bone!
[Exercise: Void Sutra!
[Supernatural power: Mahamudra of the Void!
[Recent fortune:...]
Looking at Gu Qingqiu's dashboard, Gu Changge's eyes widened.
no!
Damn it.
One night, what happened?
Gu Qingqiu only practiced for one night and reached the ninth level of opening pulses? What the hell.
Is this the rebirth of the Supreme Being?
Is cultivation just like eating and drinking?
As for Gu Qingqiu's practice of the Void Sutra, it was normal.
The other party is the Reborn Supreme, so it is not surprising that he has mastered the immortal Gu family's emperor-level skills in advance.
The outrageousness lies in the opponent's strength panel.
It can be said that it was completely different from the previous day. Finally, Gu Changge's eyes fell on Gu Qingqiu's recent fortune.
[Recent fortune: The fallen and reborn empress should have continued to have the same bumpy fate as in her previous life, with her heritage uncovered, but fate is unpredictable and unpredictable changes have occurred. Now the Supreme Bone is still hidden in her body, blessing her past life to the end. Respected wisdom, I have already had a great fortune. With the blessing and training of the God Son of the Immortal Gu Family, my strength will continue to skyrocket. In one month, I will participate in the coming-of-age ceremony trial with the Son of the Immortal Gu Family God, and obtain the holy-level "Dragon Elephant Skill" in the secret realm of the void...]
After seeing the three words "Long Xiang Gong", Gu Changge could no longer read the following words.
Gu Changge probably couldn't see the upcoming fortune.
But the previous information alone was enough for Gu Changge to digest for a while.
"Sure enough, the binding return target of the system is not simple. Just based on this little bit of recent luck, you can actually get a holy-level body-building technique."
“I don’t know what amazing opportunities I will get in the future!”
"Even the Immortal Gu family only has a dozen or so collections of holy-level body-building techniques. And it is probably extraordinary that this Dragon Elephant Technique can gain the attention of Gu Qingqiu, the reborn Supreme, and the system!"
"If I cut off my beard and give it back to Gu Qingqiu."
"Hiss... why don't you take off on the spot?"
Originally, he had immortal bones to nourish his physical body, but Gu Changge's physical strength has far exceeded that of ordinary people. If he continues to practice extraordinary body-building techniques, he may not be invincible!
OK OK.
When Gu Changge thought of this, he started to look forward to it.
